attributes.board_name: North Dakota State Board of Examiners on Audiology and Speech-Language Pathology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Courses or workshops that contribute to professional development and are approved by the Board or certified by ASHA, the American Academy of Audiology, the International Hearing Society or another Board-approved organization
rules.audit_note: Proof of completion of the CE must be filed with the renewal application; renewal is due by January 1 and the license expires if CE proof, application and fee are not filed (grace to January 31, then relicensure).
rules.notes: 10 clock hours must be completed in each calendar year (the year before the renewal year). Applies to all licensees, including speech-language pathology licensed assistants. Relicensure after a lapse requires 10 clock hours for each year unlicensed. Rules amended effective July 1, 2026 (hours unchanged). No mandatory topics.
rules.rule_quote: 2. Licensees are required to complete ten clock hours of continuing education during each calendar year.
